propositions: acli_graph.py hand-rolls the same cursor-pagination loop three times without runaway guards, allowing servers that repeat nextPageToken to spin infinitely
Server returning the same non-null nextPageToken twice consecutively must raise RunawayPaginationError that escapes fail-open exception handlers to prevent silent partial-map degradation
Shared cursor iterator _iter_cursor_pages terminates on isLast:true or absent token and centralizes runaway-token detection across all three acli_graph maps
Fail-open handlers must preserve exception-escape for RunawayPaginationError while continuing to degrade gracefully on ordinary transport faults
Offset-protocol pagers (fetcher._iter_pages, jira_datacenter/transport.py::_paged_search) remain untouched and their structural tests must stay green
